name: Industrial Fabrics, Inc.
old_description: Since 1981, Industrial Fabrics has proudly served many diverse clients in the construction, industrial and residential industries along the Gulf Coast and around the world.
about:
Industrial Fabrics, Inc. (IFI) was founded in 1981 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The company began as a pioneer in the geosynthetic industry, developing synthetic products to solve civil and geotechnical engineering problems. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

IFI manufactures and distributes a range of geosynthetic solutions including geogrids, geotextiles, geomembranes, and erosion control systems under brands such as RockGuard, GrassGuard, EnviroTubes, GreenSolutions, and BaseLok. A new $8 million production facility enables full-service manufacturing and custom fabrication. The company supports design assistance, material logistics, and on-site technical support, with over 5,000 projects completed across more than 20 states.

The firm serves engineers, contractors, and government agencies in sectors including commercial and industrial development, roadways, railways, energy, residential, marine and waterways, ports, airports, data centers, electrical, petrochemical, oil and gas, waste management, military, mining, and temporary housing.

IFI emphasizes engineered solutions backed by on-staff registered engineers, ISO-certified manufacturing, and continuing education seminars. Its mission focuses on strengthening infrastructure through innovation, integrity, and sustainability, with a reach extending from the Gulf Coast to global projects.
